policy: No entry claims a partnership, endorsement, reseller right or certification. Every relationship is 'none' until a reference exists: 'applied' needs an application reference; 'member' and 'partner' need an agreement reference, scope and expiry date. Program names, tracks and requirements are volatile and expire with their sources.

partners.name: Google Cloud
partners.contributes: Gemini models on Agent Platform, Cloud Run, Agent Search and the official icon set used in the catalog's Google Cloud views.

program.name: Google Cloud Partner Advantage
program.track: Service engagement: consulting, training and integration

partners.fit: Primary provider in the catalog and home of the Cloud Run template; a services engagement matches architecture and delivery work.
partners.next_step: Decide whether to apply under the Service engagement, then record the application reference here.

partners.name: Vercel
partners.contributes: AI SDK, AI Gateway, Functions and the deploy button behind the Vercel template; the Academy itself runs on Vercel.

program.name: Vercel solution partners
program.track: Solution partner: agencies, consultancies and systems integrators

partners.fit: Primary provider with a shipped template and the platform the Academy is hosted on.
partners.next_step: Ask Vercel partnerships for the solution partner criteria, which are not published.

partners.name: Cloudflare
partners.contributes: Workers, Workers AI, AI Gateway and AI Search; runs the Cloudflare template.

program.name: Cloudflare Partner Network
program.track: Services partner tracks, or the self-serve agency program (beta)

partners.fit: Primary provider with a shipped template; the edge runtime suits low-cost grounded answers.
partners.next_step: Compare the agency program with the authorized service delivery track before applying.

partners.name: AWS
partners.contributes: Bedrock, AgentCore and the Generative AI Lens referenced by the AWS realizations.

program.name: AWS Partner Network
program.track: Services path: Select, Advanced and Premier tiers

partners.fit: Secondary provider in the catalog with no template yet.
partners.next_step: Ship an AWS template of the answer contract before considering the services path.

partners.name: Microsoft Azure
partners.contributes: Microsoft Foundry and the Azure AI workload guidance referenced by the Azure realizations.

program.name: Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program
program.track: Membership through a verified Partner Center account

partners.fit: Secondary provider; strongest where customers already run Entra ID and Microsoft 365.
partners.next_step: Ship an Azure template before joining; membership needs a verified Partner Center account.

partners.name: Railway
partners.contributes: Container services, managed Postgres and cron for the Railway realizations.

program.name: Railway templates and kickback
program.track: Template creator; open source and technology partner programs

partners.fit: Every pattern is realized on Railway, but no Railway template ships yet.
partners.next_step: Publish the answer-contract template to the Railway marketplace, where published templates earn a usage share.

partners.name: Anthropic
partners.contributes: Claude models, the Model Context Protocol and Claude Code, which runs the AI Architect plugin and skills.
partners.fit: The plugin and skills run in Claude Code, and the Vercel template routes to a Claude model by default.
partners.next_step: Read the services track requirements on the official page; tier figures in press coverage are unverified.

partners.name: OpenAI
partners.contributes: GPT models, function calling, Structured Outputs and the image model named in the catalog's image recipes.

program.name: OpenAI Partner Network
program.track: Reported tiers: Select, Advanced and Elite

partners.fit: Image recipes name an OpenAI image model; no template routes to OpenAI by default.
partners.next_step: Find the official program page before acting; only secondary coverage was found.

partners.name: NVIDIA
partners.contributes: Accelerated computing for self-hosted and fine-tuned models; no catalog realization uses it today.

program.name: NVIDIA Partner Network
program.track: Consulting and solution partner types with competency levels

partners.fit: Relevant only for customers who self-host or fine-tune models; the catalog uses managed model APIs.
partners.next_step: No action until a pattern needs self-hosted inference.

partners.name: Model Context Protocol
partners.contributes: The tool and context protocol behind the enterprise MCP tool hub pattern and the AI Architect MCP server.

program.name: Agentic AI Foundation (Linux Foundation)
program.track: Open governance; contributions through the public specification process

partners.fit: Core to the tool hub pattern; the engine ships its own MCP server.
partners.next_step: Track specification changes and contribute only through the public process.

partners.name: Agent2Agent protocol
partners.contributes: Agent discovery and task exchange across vendors, complementary to MCP.
partners.fit: Not used by any pattern yet; a candidate for the coordinated-agents pattern.
partners.next_step: Evaluate it for the agentic operations workflow before adopting it.

partners.name: OpenTelemetry
partners.contributes: Trace and metric conventions, including generative AI spans, for the observability role.

program.name: OpenTelemetry (CNCF)
program.track: Open governance; generative AI conventions in Development status

partners.fit: Every pattern has an observability role, and the generative AI conventions are not yet stable.
partners.next_step: Pin a conventions version in the templates once they stabilize.

partners.name: C4 model and Structurizr
partners.contributes: The C4 views and the Structurizr DSL that every pattern exports.
partners.fit: Every pattern compiles to a Structurizr workspace with one deployment environment per provider.
partners.next_step: Keep exports parseable by the Structurizr DSL library and credit the method in documentation.

partners.name: xyflow (React Flow)
partners.contributes: The React Flow library behind the Studio canvas and the React Flow exports.
partners.next_step: Consider financially supporting the maintainers if the Studio becomes a product surface.

partners.name: Mermaid
partners.contributes: Text-defined flowcharts and journey sequences exported for every pattern and provider.
partners.fit: Every realization exports a Mermaid flowchart, and every pattern a journey sequence.
partners.next_step: Keep exports rendering in the pinned Mermaid version and in GitHub Markdown.

partners.name: diagrams.net (draw.io)
partners.contributes: Editable diagram files exported for every realization, sharing component IDs with the other views.
partners.fit: The editable hand-off format for architects who refine diagrams by hand.
partners.next_step: Keep exports opening cleanly in the desktop and web editors.
